# anthropic_rate_limits (Data Source)

Lists the organization's Messages API rate limits, one entry per rate limit group (`GET /v1/organizations/rate_limits`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_rate_limits" "all" {}

data "anthropic_rate_limits" "model_groups" {
  group_type = "model_group"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `group_type` (String) Only return groups of this type: `model_group`, `batch`, `token_count`, `files`, `skills`, or `web_search`.
- `model` (String) Only return the entry containing this model name or alias. The API returns 404 if the model has no rate limits.

### Read-Only

- `rate_limits` (Attributes List) Rate limit entries. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rate_limits))

<a id="nestedatt--rate_limits"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rate_limits`

Read-Only:

- `group_display_name` (String) Display name of a model group, for display only. Null for other group types.
- `group_id` (String) Rate limit group identifier, the same in every organization.
- `group_type` (String) Group type.
- `id` (String) Entry identifier, unique per organization. Use it as `rate_limit_id` on `anthropic_workspace_rate_limit`.
- `limits` (Map of Number) Limit values keyed by limiter type (for example `requests_per_minute`).
- `models` (List of String) Model names and aliases the entry covers. Null when `group_type` is not `model_group`.
